name: T3 Code Server
description: Installs T3 Code as a pinned release runtime, runs it as an s6-overlay service under the selected user, and lets that user update it in place with t3code-server-update.

version.description: T3 Code version to install. With upstream, `latest` follows GitHub's latest upstream release. With a GitHub source, `latest` selects the greatest stable `server/*-wyrd.*` tag by SemVer precedence.

packageSource.description: Optional GitHub repository source such as `github:wyrd-company/t3code`, or an npm package spec or tarball URL. Empty installs upstream T3 Code.

port.description: Port exposed by the T3 Code server.

host.description: Interface to bind the T3 Code server to.

serveMode.description: Optional T3 runtime mode passed to `t3 serve --mode`. Set to `web` for the web runtime. Empty preserves the T3 CLI default.

serviceUser.description: User account to run the service as. `automatic` prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.

dnsName.description: Optional fully qualified DNS name exposed through the Caddy Feature, such as `t3.dev-environment.example.test`.
